verdict.rationale: Snyk ships a documented MCP server and 'Snyk Studio' hooks-based integration explicitly designed to scan AI-generated code in agentic dev environments before it lands, plus a Remediation Agent invoked via /snyk-fix or snyk fix --agentic inside coding assistants. A live probe confirms the MCP server actually starts and responds to JSON-RPC initialize, validating the integration works as documented.
